plan.title: feat(costs): regenerate the token spend report post-rebrand — backfill cost events from stored JSONL conversations, no legacy DB import
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PRD draft (glossary, verified references, decisions D1-D8)

narratives.Problem: The public token spend report is stale and unpublished after the Panopticon→Overdeck rebrand: the current cost store ~/.overdeck/costs/events.jsonl starts exactly at the rebrand (min ts 2026-06-19T18:30:25Z), eltmon.github.io/overdeck/token-spend-report/ returns 404 because the repo has NO GitHub Pages site configured (gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pages → 404, no workflow exists), and docs/token-spend-report/index.html still carries pre-rebrand data (734,117 calls / ~$54k) with an obsolete two-source generation procedure. The operator's architectural bet: cost history is derivable from harness session JSONL still on disk — no legacy DB import needed.
narratives.Proposal: Ship a durable `pan cost backfill` CLI command (dry-run default, --write to execute) that sweeps ALL known session stores through the existing machinery: the never-called full Claude-projects sweep reconcile() in src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts:717, plus the CostWriter door's ohmypi/codex reconciles (src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts ~:536) extended with extra scan roots for global ~/.codex/sessions (content back to 2026-02-19), global ~/.pi/agent/sessions (back to 2026-04-11), and legacy ~/.panopticon/agents/*/sessions (~2026-05). All writes go through CostWriter.record() (requestId dedup, sourceFile fallback) — idempotent and read-only on session files. Then run the backfill on this machine, regenerate docs/token-spend-report/index.html from the merged store as the single source with an honest per-harness coverage banner and an archival note about the deliberately-not-imported pre-rebrand era, fix the 404 with a Pages deploy workflow publishing only docs/token-spend-report/, and land a repo-tracked dev skill documenting the post-rebrand procedure. Full decisions D1-D8 and hazards in .pan/drafts/pan-2389.md and continue.json.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No import of ~/.panopticon/costs/events.jsonl (686k events) or ~/.panopticon/panopticon.db — proving they are unnecessary is the point of the issue
- No codex/ohmypi parser accuracy fixes beyond exposing session cwd for attribution (PAN-2388 owns parsers)
- No UNKNOWN-bucket attribution redesign, no by-issue rollup fixes, no dashboard Costs page changes (PAN-2387 owns those)
- No evolution/gource video regeneration
- No attempt to recover pre-May-2026 Claude Code transcript history — the coverage boundary is reported honestly, not worked around
- No changes to the live cost hook or the scheduled pi reconcile cadence
- No modification, rename, or deletion of any session JSONL file anywhere

autoDecisions.summary: Backfill is a durable `pan cost backfill` CLI subcommand, not a one-off script
autoDecisions.rationale: Cache-derivability is a maintained system property; the capability must outlive this issue. Precedent scripts/backfill-costs-pan1570.mts was a throwaway; the issue frames the bet as ongoing.

autoDecisions.summary: Dry-run default with --write to execute; dry-run persists nothing (no record(), no offsets/seen state)
autoDecisions.rationale: The command appends thousands of events; safe default costs nothing. Persisting offsets during dry-run would silently starve the later --write run (H2).

autoDecisions.summary: Do not block on open issues PAN-2387/PAN-2388; proceed with current parsers and disclose attribution limits in the report
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue itself frames it as 'should land first OR the backfill inherits the UNKNOWN bucket' — inheriting with honest labeling is the smallest acceptable option; append-only dedup makes later re-runs safe (though they won't retro-correct attribution, which is disclosed).

autoDecisions.summary: Extra scan roots are parameterized in CostWriter.reconcile (src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts), keeping cost-parsers/* internals untouched
autoDecisions.rationale: Minimizes conflict surface with in-flight PAN-2388 and keeps the single write door as the only ingest path (single-source-of-truth tenet).

autoDecisions.summary: Codex backfill keeps the door's per-session-file event granularity with sourceFile dedup
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the existing, dedup-correct shape; PAN-2388 owns finer accuracy. Changing granularity here would duplicate in-flight work.

autoDecisions.summary: Pages fix is a workflow-based deploy (configure-pages enablement:true) publishing ONLY docs/token-spend-report/
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo has no Pages site at all; a checked-in workflow is reproducible, and the docs/ tree is Mintlify source for overdeck.ai that must not be served raw.

autoDecisions.summary: The regenerated report presents the post-rebrand store as its dataset and labels the pre-rebrand era (Feb 2025–Jun 2026, 734,117 calls, ~$54k) as archival, deliberately not imported
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured coverage: Claude transcripts on disk only reach ~May/Jun 2026 (cleanup pruned older); codex reaches Feb 2026, pi Apr 2026. Honest boundary reporting is an explicit issue requirement.

items.title: Add `pan cost backfill [--write]` running the full Claude sweep + door reconciles with a coverage summary

expected_outputs: reconciler backfill tests pass including the dry-run-persists-nothing assertion

narrative.Action: In src/cli/commands/cost.ts (the `pan cost` group at line 117), add a `backfill` subcommand with a `--write` flag. It calls (a) the exported-but-never-called full Claude-projects sweep `reconcile()` from src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts:717, and (b) `CostWriter.reconcile({source:'ohmypi'})` and `{source:'codex'}` via the cost door layers (follow how reconciler.ts builds CostDoorLive for its own writes). Thread a `dryRun` option through `reconcilePromise()` and the door reconcile so that WITHOUT --write nothing is persisted: no `record()` calls, no `saveSessionOffset()`/seen-set writes (decision D2 / hazard H2 in continue.json). After the run, print a per-source coverage summary: sessions scanned, events imported (or would-import in dry-run), duplicates skipped, errors, earliest and latest imported event ts. Add a fixture-backed test under a temp HOME (src/lib/costs paths resolve process.env.HOME) asserting: dry-run leaves events.jsonl and the costs/state dir byte-identical, and a --write run over a synthetic Claude transcript imports events then imports 0 on the second run.

items.title: Given a synthetic Claude transcript under a temp HOME, `pan cost backfill --write` imports its cost events and a second identical run imports 0 (summary reports duplicates instead)
Without --write, the command prints would-import counts and preserves events.jsonl and ~/.overdeck/costs/state byte-identical (asserted by test)
The summary output prints per-source sessions scanned, events imported, duplicates skipped, errors, and earliest/latest imported event timestamp
All imports flow through CostWriter.record() — the diff contains no direct events.jsonl appends and no direct cost_events SQL inserts outside the door
Extend the cost door's codex reconcile with extra scan roots including global ~/.codex/sessions

expected_outputs: codex extra-roots fixture test passes including idempotent second run

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/cost.ts, extend `CostWriter.reconcile` opts from `{source}` to also accept extra scan roots (e.g. `{source, extraRoots?: string[]}`), defaulting to today's per-agent walk under $OVERDECK_HOME/agents. For source 'codex', when the global codex home root ($CODEX_HOME, default ~/.codex, sessions under sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl per codex-parser.ts:4) is passed, walk it recursively and emit one event per session file exactly like the existing codex branch: parseCodexSessionSync(), sourceFile dedup, ts = session start. Attribution: derive issueId from the session's cwd (codex session_meta carries `cwd`; expose it from parseCodexSessionSync's return if not already present — keep the parser diff to that minimum, PAN-2388 owns parser accuracy per decision D3) using the same issue-from-path inference the reconciler uses (see inferIssueFromPath in src/lib/costs/reconciler.ts); fall back to the existing issueIdFromAgentName only for per-agent roots. agentId for global-root sessions: 'codex-global'. Fixture test under a temp HOME/CODEX_HOME: a synthetic rollout JSONL with session_meta cwd containing 'feature-pan-1234' yields one event with issueId PAN-1234, the parsed model id, token counts, sourceFile set; running reconcile twice imports the event exactly once.

A session_meta cwd containing a workspace path like feature-pan-1234 produces issueId PAN-1234; a non-issue cwd falls back to UNKNOWN
Running the same reconcile twice persists exactly one event row — the second run marks it as a duplicate and imports 0
The default per-agent walk behaves exactly as before when no extra roots are passed (existing tests keep passing)
Sweep global ~/.pi/agent/sessions and legacy ~/.panopticon/agents pi transcripts via the roots mechanism

expected_outputs: pi extra-roots fixture tests pass including requestId dedup on re-run

narrative.Action: Using the roots mechanism from door-scan-roots, make the backfill's ohmypi sweep also cover: (a) the global pi store ~/.pi/agent/sessions/<encoded-cwd-dirname>/*.jsonl — infer issueId from the encoded cwd directory name (same inference family as inferIssueFromPath; dir names look like --home-eltmon-Projects-panopticon-cli-workspaces-feature-pan-1788--), agentId 'pi-global'; and (b) the legacy per-agent store ~/.panopticon/agents/<id>/sessions/**/*.jsonl — issueId via the existing issueIdFromAgentName(agentName), agentId = the legacy agent dir name. Reuse the existing pi parse path (parseOhmypiSessionCostEventsSync / extractPiCostEvents shape with provider responseId as requestId dedup). Both roots are read-only. Wire these roots into the `pan cost backfill` invocation from the backfill-cli bead. Fixture tests under a temp HOME mirroring the codex bead: one global-pi fixture and one legacy-agent fixture, each asserting issueId attribution, token/model fields, and exactly-once import across two runs.

Execute the backfill on this machine and capture the coverage summary

expected_outputs: earliest event ts in ~/.overdeck/costs/events.jsonl is earlier than 2026-06-19 and the command exits 0

narrative.Action: Operational bead — runs on this machine against real data; all preceding code beads must be merged into this workspace branch first. Steps: (1) Confirm the planning-time safety snapshot ~/.overdeck/costs/events.jsonl.pre-pan2389-backfill.bak exists (37,158 lines) — do NOT proceed without it, never delete or overwrite it (hazard H7). (2) Run `pan cost backfill` in default dry-run mode via the workspace CLI (e.g. `npx tsx src/cli/index.ts cost backfill`) and sanity-check the would-import counts and per-source coverage. (3) Run with --write. (4) Run with --write AGAIN and verify the second run imports 0 events (idempotence proof). (5) Record the final coverage summary (per-source earliest/latest event ts, events imported, sessions scanned, duplicates) into docs/token-spend-report/coverage.json (new small JSON committed to the branch) for the report bead to consume. All session files are opened read-only; nothing under ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.pi, or ~/.panopticon is modified (NFR-1).

narrative.Action: Regenerate docs/token-spend-report/index.html using ~/.overdeck/costs/events.jsonl as the SINGLE data source (decision D6 — no SQLite combine, no ~/.panopticon files). Compute aggregates with a node script that sorts/scans by ts (hazard H3: backfill appends out of order): total spend/calls/tokens hero stats, models (top 10), providers, sessionType stages, monthly costs, top-15 issues, dailyCosts. Update the reportData object and hero counters; preserve the existing structure and style rules (dark theme #0f172a, monthly chart stays type 'bar' with borderRadius 6/borderSkipped false, subscription chart labels unchanged, model cards pattern). Update the hero h1 dollar figure to the new-store total; do not claim continuity with the $54k figure. Update git-derived stats (commit count, fileGrowth via the git ls-tree per-day snapshot method — never per-commit churn) only if already stale; skip video regeneration (NonGoal).

verify_commands: python3 -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/pages.yml')); assert d['permissions']['pages']=='write' and d['permissions']['id-token']=='write'; print('pages.yml valid, permissions correct')"
expected_outputs: pages.yml parses as valid YAML with pages: write and id-token: write permissions

narrative.Action: Create .github/workflows/pages.yml per decision D7. Root cause verified 2026-07-05: gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pages returns 404 — the repo has no Pages site; the configuration did not survive the rebrand. Workflow: name 'Deploy token spend report to GitHub Pages'; triggers on push to main with paths filter docs/token-spend-report/** plus workflow_dispatch; permissions contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write; concurrency group 'pages'. Job steps: checkout; stage `mkdir -p _site && cp -r docs/token-spend-report _site/` (publish ONLY the report — the docs/ tree is Mintlify source for overdeck.ai and must not be served raw); actions/configure-pages@v5 with `enablement: true` (creates the Pages site on first run — hazard H5); actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 with path _site; actions/deploy-pages@v4 in a deploy environment (environment name github-pages, url from the deploy step output). Resulting URL: https://eltmon.github.io/overdeck/token-spend-report/. Post-merge verification (test/UAT role, cannot run pre-merge): after the first successful workflow run on main, curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' on that URL returns 200.

configure-pages runs with enablement: true so the first run creates the Pages site on a repo that currently has none
